_README: Industry events / semiconductor conferences that can move watchlist names via product announcements, roadmap disclosures, or competitive read-through. The morning routine (CLAUDE.md) refreshes dates and 'watch' notes via web search each run and adds newly-announced events. 'tickers' = watchlist symbols with direct or read-through exposure. 'partners' = KEY PRIVATE/NON-WATCHLIST COMPANIES whose appearances matter because a holding depends on them (e.g. Ayar Labs is Sivers' flagship CPO customer; Lightmatter is the CPO peer benchmark). ADDED 2026-08-07 after OCP APAC was missed: relevance must be checked against BOTH tickers and partners, and MAJOR EVENT SERIES HAVE REGIONAL EDITIONS (OCP runs Global + APAC + EMEA; SEMICON runs West/Taiwan/Europe/Korea) — enumerate every edition, not just the flagship. 'confidence': confirmed (dates verified) | approx (typical timing, verify) | rumored. Dates ISO YYYY-MM-DD, event-local. Not investment advice.

events.name: ECOC 2026 (European Conference on Optical Communication)
events.watch: THE optics event for the small-caps: CPO (co-packaged optics), 800G/1.6T transceivers, EML/DFB laser and InP-substrate progress. Direct catalyst window for Sivers (CPO lasers) and Soitec (photonics substrates); DSP/optics read-through for MRVL & AVGO. Lumentum/Coherent disclosures here reset the whole InP supply picture. **Re-verified 2026-09-08 (week's first run) — 12 days out and inside the 14-day window.** Dates and venue confirmed at source and via trade listings: **conference 20-24 Sep, exhibition floor 21-23 Sep, Málaga, Spain** (note the split — the exhibition is only the middle three days, so vendor announcements cluster Sep 21-23, not Sep 20). **The Market Focus programme is the sharpening that matters this pass:** published themes are **scale-up vs scale-out architectures, co-packaged optics, silicon photonics, photonics packaging, optical interconnects, laser innovation, and 'beyond 1.6T'**, with dedicated sessions on components/ICs/PICs/fibre and on the optical future of AI infrastructure. **Named Market Focus contributors include Coherent, Lumentum, Ciena, Credo, Source Photonics, Cisco, Corning, Adtran, Huawei, China Telecom and 1Finity** — so COHR, LITE and CIEN each have a speaking presence, not merely a booth, which is what makes the standing note's 'Lumentum/Coherent disclosures reset the InP supply picture' testable this year rather than assumed. 'Laser innovation' as its own named track is the direct SIVE.ST/SIVEF read (InP CW DFB for CPO light sources) and pairs with the CIOE (Sep 9-11) China read two weeks earlier — same layer, two very different sources of evidence. **Calibrate: a conference-plus-trade-show, so expect roadmap, papers and product positioning, not guidance; nothing scheduled here adjudicates a falsifier.** It overlaps GTS Taiwan (Sep 24), so optics-relevant disclosure from both lands in the same window. **Re-verified 2026-09-12 run — 8 days out.** Dates, venue and the conference/exhibition split re-confirmed at source: **conference Sep 20-24, exhibition floor Sep 21-23, Málaga, Spain** (note: several third-party listings still say Madrid — Málaga is correct per ECOC's own site). **New this pass, and the first company-sourced ECOC item of the cycle: Coherent issued a press release on 2026-09-08 detailing its ECOC program**, which converts the standing 'Lumentum/Coherent disclosures reset the InP supply picture' note from assumption into a scheduled, named event. Named Coherent content includes a session titled **'Co-Packaged Optics: From Industry Promise to Reality' (speaker Justin Abbott)** plus talks on datacenter cooling, CPO and AI network scaling and a **2.3Tbit/s** demonstration. **Read it for what it is: a vendor program announcement, so expect positioning and demos rather than volume or supplier disclosure.** Trade previews frame the show's central question as **where pluggables, linear-drive (LPO), near-packaged and co-packaged optics each land in AI systems as the industry steps 800G -> 1.6T -> 3.2T** — the same layer the SIVE.ST/SIVEF (InP CW DFB light source) and SOI.PA read sits in. **Cross-read note: CIOE (Sep 9-11, Shenzhen) has now happened and its entry has been retired from this file; ECOC is the Western-sourced counterpart on the identical layer, so the two together are the September component-supply read.** Nothing scheduled here adjudicates a falsifier. **Re-verified 2026-09-17 run — 3 days out.** Dates/venue unchanged at source (conference Sep 20-24, exhibition Sep 21-23, Málaga). **New this pass — the Lumentum counterpart to the Coherent program logged 2026-09-12, and the more directly SIVE-relevant of the two: Lumentum published its ECOC speaker line-up (stand #2050) with five talks, including VP Loukas Paraschis on 'Laser Innovations Enabling the New Photonics Ecosystem Optimized for AI System Interconnect' (Sep 22), CTO Matt Sysak on channel scalability (Sep 20) and at the Silicon Photonics Workshop (Sep 22), Erman Timurdogan on 800G/1.6T silicon photonic transmitters and Matthew Peters on 1060nm VCSEL arrays (both Sep 23).** That puts a named laser-innovation session from the incumbent CW-laser supplier on the exact layer the SIVE.ST/SIVEF thesis contests. **Calibrate honestly: this is a speaker-list press item — the release carries NO statement on CW laser supply, capacity or allocation, which is the variable the SIVE case actually turns on. A trade summary also reports a 1310nm >1.0W CPO light source from Lumentum; that spec was NOT in the company page read this pass, so treat it as unconfirmed until sourced.** Still no evidence of a Sivers presence in the published ECOC program. Nothing scheduled here adjudicates a falsifier. **Re-verified 2026-09-18 run — 2 days out, final check before the event.** Dates/venue unchanged at source (conference Sep 20-24, exhibition Sep 21-23, Málaga); note ECOC's own exhibition page headlines the show as 21-23 September, which is the exhibition floor, not the conference. **Two additions this pass, one of which adds a watchlist ticker to this entry.** **(1) Tower Semiconductor (TSEM — watchlist) is showcasing its silicon-photonics platform at ECOC 2026, positioned for near- and co-packaged optics.** TSEM has therefore been added to this entry's tickers; it is the first ECOC presence this file has logged for the specialty-foundry side of the photonics chain, and it sits alongside the GFS silicon-photonics read carried on the GTS entries — two watchlist foundries on the same PIC layer in the same week. **(2) Lumentum's ECOC content is now specified one level below the speaker list logged 2026-09-17: external laser source modules (ELSFP) in a pluggable form factor built around ultra-high-power 1310nm lasers, aimed explicitly at CPO architectures, with sampling indicated for Q1 2026.** That is the external-laser-source socket itself — the exact component position the SIVE.ST/SIVEF InP CW DFB case contests — so it is the most directly competitive ECOC item logged this cycle. It also partially sources the 1310nm >1.0W CPO light source flagged as UNCONFIRMED on 2026-09-17, though the power figure still comes from trade summary rather than from Lumentum, so treat >1.0W as unconfirmed. **Calibrate: 'sampling', not volume — a product-positioning disclosure with no capacity, allocation or customer attached, which remains the variable the SIVE case turns on.** Also new: OIF is running live multi-vendor interop with 39 member companies at booth #2126. **Still no evidence of a Sivers presence in the published ECOC program.** Nothing scheduled here adjudicates a falsifier.

events.name: GlobalFoundries Technology Summit (GTS) 2026 — China
events.watch: **ADDED 2026-09-03 (promoted from the GTS North America entry, whose Sep 2 date has now passed and which was removed this run).** GF's flagship customer/partner technology summit runs as a regional series; per the README's regional-edition rule the remaining 2026 editions each get their own entry as they come inside the 30-day window. **Dates re-verified this run against GF's own GTS page: Shanghai Sep 22, Hsinchu Sep 24, Munich Oct 15.** Format is GF and industry-leader keynotes plus deep dives into GF's differentiated process platforms (RF-SOI, silicon photonics, FD-SOI, automotive/power) and customer/ecosystem results. **Why it matters for GFS: this is where the specialty-foundry case acquires roadmap and design-win evidence bearing on the drivers "specialty mix defends pricing vs commodity nodes" and "silicon photonics becomes a real revenue line as CPO scales" — it does NOT bear on the pricing-war or utilisation falsifiers.** Secondary read: GF is named in the SIVE thesis as an ecosystem partner (GlobalFoundries reference designs for hyperscalers incl. AMD), so any silicon-photonics platform announcement is a read-through into the CPO chain. **Calibrate honestly: a customer/partner technology event, not an investor day — expect platform and partnership announcements, not guidance, and no session-level agenda is published at source for these editions as of this pass. Nothing here adjudicates a falsifier.** **Regional angle specific to this edition: it lands in the Asian supply chain days after SEMICON Taiwan (Sep 2-4) and CIOE (Sep 9-11), so any GF photonics platform news here can be cross-read against what those two shows produce.** 19 days out.

events.name: Marvell Technology Investor Day 2026
events.location: New York City (in-person by invitation; live webcast)
events.watch: **ADDED 2026-08-18 (morning run) — a real calendar gap: a watchlist company has a confirmed, dated, WEBCAST management event and this calendar did not carry it.** **Marvell announced on 2026-08-03, in the same release that set its Q2 FY2027 earnings call, that it will hold an Investor Day on the morning of Tue Oct 6, 2026 in New York City, with Chairman and CEO Matt Murphy and the senior leadership team presenting.** In-person attendance is by invitation only, but **the event is webcast live via the Events section of investor.marvell.com** — which is what separates this from the broker conferences elsewhere on this calendar: it is a company-controlled disclosure venue with a public feed, not a 1x1 program. It sat unlogged for fifteen days. **Why it matters for this book specifically: an investor day is where multi-year financial targets and segment models get set, and MRVL is the one watchlist name whose thesis turns on a disclosure of exactly that kind.** The MRVL falsifiers are "loss/insourcing of a flagship custom program", "CPO disintermediates pluggable DSPs faster than Marvell adapts", and a shift in data-center guide language — all three are TAM-and-roadmap claims that an investor day either substantiates with a model or conspicuously does not. **Sequencing is the other reason to carry it: the Q2 FY2027 print lands Thu Aug 27 at 1:45pm PT, five and a half weeks BEFORE this event**, so the quarter sets the near-term facts and the investor day sets the multi-year frame on top of them. Note the tape context this is being scheduled into: **UBS cut its MRVL target 340 → 300 on 2026-08-17**, and the name has run 74 → 316 and back inside six months. **Nothing here adjudicates a falsifier yet — it is a scheduled opportunity for one to be adjudicated.** 49 days out; outside the 30-day window, carried so it is not missed again.

events.name: OCP Global Summit 2026 (Open Compute Project)
events.watch: Hyperscaler datacenter standards — rack power/cooling, networking fabrics, custom silicon, optics adoption. Meta is a core OCP driver (capex read-through); networking/optics read-through for AVGO & MRVL; datacenter-infrastructure read-through for WULF's HPC-conversion thesis.

events.name: SEMICON West 2026
events.watch: Dates confirmed 2026-07-22 via the official SEMI organizer site (Pre-Show Day Mon Oct 12, show floor Oct 13-15). Fab-equipment/WFE industry event, almost exactly overlapping the existing OCP Global Summit (Oct 12-15, San Jose) — same catalyst week. Relevant to TSM (leading-edge capacity/pricing commentary) and GFS (specialty-foundry, onshoring/CHIPS Act positioning).

events.name: IEDM 2026 (72nd IEEE International Electron Devices Meeting)
events.watch: Added 2026-07-30: premier device-physics/process-tech conference, theme 'Devices at the Heart of the Intelligence Revolution.' Expect next-node transistor (GAA/CFET) and advanced-packaging/substrate papers directly relevant to Soitec's SOI/substrate roadmap plus TSM/INTC/GFS process roadmaps. Detailed accepted-paper program not yet released; dates flagged 'subject to change' by some listings — verify closer to the event.

events.name: CES 2027
events.watch: Consumer + edge-AI keynotes; NVIDIA typically opens with a roadmap/keynote. Broad AI-infrastructure tone-setter for the year. 60th-anniversary edition.

events.name: OFC 2027 (Optical Fiber Communication Conference & Exposition)
events.watch: Added 2026-07-30: the largest global optics show — the semiannual bookend to ECOC for CPO/transceiver/InP-laser roadmap disclosures (1.6T/3.2T transceivers, co-packaged optics), directly feeding the Sivers/Soitec thesis.

events.name: NVIDIA GTC 2027
events.watch: NVIDIA's flagship — next-gen architecture (post-Rubin) roadmap, networking (NVLink/Spectrum), and increasingly CPO/optics partners. The single biggest AI-infra catalyst of the year; read-through across the entire watchlist, especially the optics chain if NVDA advances co-packaged optics.

events.name: OCP EMEA Summit 2027 (Open Compute Project)
events.watch: **ROLLED FORWARD 2026-08-12 (end-of-day run): the 2026 EMEA edition's end date (2026-04-22) had passed, and this entry has been replaced with the confirmed 2027 edition — Apr 6-8, 2027, Hamburg, Germany**, verified against OCP's own summit page. This is the placeholder the 2026 entry was explicitly being kept for, so the series stays fully enumerated (Global + APAC + EMEA) without carrying a dead date. Far out of the alert window; relevance is the same as the other OCP editions — open datacenter hardware, rack power/cooling, networking fabrics and optics adoption, with the photonics chain (Lightmatter as the CPO peer benchmark) the reason this book tracks the series at all.

partners_to_track.Ayar Labs: Sivers' flagship CPO customer (SuperNova light source on GF SiPi). Any Ayar roadmap/timeline disclosure is a direct SIVE input.
partners_to_track.Lightmatter: CPO peer benchmark; on-package optical demos with MRVL. Sets the competitive bar for the optics chain.
partners_to_track.Win Semiconductors: SIVE's outsourced InP wafer capacity — allocation disclosures are core to the SIVE capacity math.
partners_to_track.CXMT: China DRAM champion; the EWY / SK hynix structural falsifier. Listed on STAR 2026-07-27.
partners_to_track.Huawei / Zhipu: China independent AI stack (Ascend, CANN, GLM-5) — the NVDA ecosystem-breach falsifier.
